lines.text: To serve me well, you all should do me duty:
lines.plainText: To serve me well you all should do me duty

lines.text: Teach me to be your queen, and you my subjects.
lines.plainText: Teach me to be your queen and you my subjects

lines.text: O, serve me well, and teach yourselves that duty!
lines.plainText: O serve me well and teach yourselves that duty

lines.text: Dispute not with her; she is lunatic.
lines.plainText: Dispute not with her she is lunatic

lines.text: Peace, Master Marquess, you are malapert.
lines.plainText: Peace Master Marquess you are malapert

lines.text: Your fire-new stamp of honour is scarce current.
lines.plainText: Your firenew stamp of honour is scarce current

lines.text: O, that your young nobility could judge
lines.plainText: O that your young nobility could judge

lines.text: What 'twere to lose it and be miserable!
lines.plainText: What 'twere to lose it and be miserable

lines.text: They that stand high have many blasts to shake them,
lines.plainText: They that stand high have many blasts to shake them

lines.text: And if they fall they dash themselves to pieces.
lines.plainText: And if they fall they dash themselves to pieces

lines.text: Good counsel, marry. Learn it, learn it, Marquess.
lines.plainText: Good counsel marry Learn it learn it Marquess

lines.text: It touches you, my lord, as much as me.
lines.plainText: It touches you my lord as much as me

lines.text: Ay, and much more; but I was born so high.
lines.plainText: Ay and much more but I was born so high

lines.text: Our aery buildeth in the cedar's top,
lines.plainText: Our aery buildeth in the cedar's top

lines.text: And dallies with the wind, and scorns the sun.
lines.plainText: And dallies with the wind and scorns the sun

lines.text: And turns the sun to shade, alas, alas!
lines.plainText: And turns the sun to shade alas alas

lines.text: Witness my son, now in the shade of death,
lines.plainText: Witness my son now in the shade of death

lines.text: Whose bright out-shining beams thy cloudy wrath
lines.plainText: Whose bright outshining beams thy cloudy wrath

lines.text: Hath in eternal darkness folded up.
lines.plainText: Hath in eternal darkness folded up

lines.text: Your aery buildeth in our aery's nest.
lines.plainText: Your aery buildeth in our aery's nest

lines.text: O God, that seest it, do not suffer it!
lines.plainText: O God that seest it do not suffer it

lines.text: As it is won with blood, lost be it so.
lines.plainText: As it is won with blood lost be it so

lines.text: Peace, peace, for shame, if not for charity.
lines.plainText: Peace peace for shame if not for charity

lines.text: Urge neither charity nor shame to me.
lines.plainText: Urge neither charity nor shame to me

lines.text: Uncharitably with me have you dealt,
lines.plainText: Uncharitably with me have you dealt

lines.text: And shamefully my hopes by you are butchered.
lines.plainText: And shamefully my hopes by you are butchered

lines.text: My charity is outrage, life my shame,
lines.plainText: My charity is outrage life my shame

lines.text: And in that shame still live my sorrow's rage.
lines.plainText: And in that shame still live my sorrow's rage

lines.text: Have done, have done.
lines.plainText: Have done have done

lines.text: O princely Buckingham, I'll kiss thy hand
lines.plainText: O princely Buckingham I'll kiss thy hand

lines.text: In sign of league and amity with thee.
lines.plainText: In sign of league and amity with thee

lines.text: Now fair befall thee and thy noble house!
lines.plainText: Now fair befall thee and thy noble house

lines.text: Thy garments are not spotted with our blood,
lines.plainText: Thy garments are not spotted with our blood

lines.text: Nor thou within the compass of my curse.
lines.plainText: Nor thou within the compass of my curse

lines.text: Nor no one here, for curses never pass
lines.plainText: Nor no one here for curses never pass

lines.text: The lips of those that breathe them in the air.
lines.plainText: The lips of those that breathe them in the air

lines.text: I will not think but they ascend the sky,
lines.plainText: I will not think but they ascend the sky

lines.text: And there awake God's gentle sleeping peace.
lines.plainText: And there awake God's gentle sleeping peace

lines.text: O Buckingham, take heed of yonder dog!
lines.plainText: O Buckingham take heed of yonder dog

lines.text: Look when he fawns, he bites; and when he bites,
lines.plainText: Look when he fawns he bites and when he bites

lines.text: His venom tooth will rankle to the death.
lines.plainText: His venom tooth will rankle to the death

lines.text: Have not to do with him; beware of him;
lines.plainText: Have not to do with him beware of him

lines.text: Sin, death, and hell have set their marks on him,
lines.plainText: Sin death and hell have set their marks on him

lines.text: And all their ministers attend on him.
lines.plainText: And all their ministers attend on him

lines.text: What doth she say, my lord of Buckingham?
lines.plainText: What doth she say my lord of Buckingham

lines.text: Nothing that I respect, my gracious lord.
lines.plainText: Nothing that I respect my gracious lord

lines.text: What, dost thou scorn me for my gentle counsel,
lines.plainText: What dost thou scorn me for my gentle counsel

lines.text: And soothe the devil that I warn thee from?
lines.plainText: And soothe the devil that I warn thee from

lines.text: O, but remember this another day,
lines.plainText: O but remember this another day

lines.text: When he shall split thy very heart with sorrow,
lines.plainText: When he shall split thy very heart with sorrow

lines.text: And say, poor Margaret was a prophetess.
lines.plainText: And say poor Margaret was a prophetess

lines.text: Live each of you the subjects to his hate,
lines.plainText: Live each of you the subjects to his hate

lines.text: And he to yours, and all of you to God's!
lines.plainText: And he to yours and all of you to God's

lines.text: My hair doth stand on end to hear her curses.
lines.plainText: My hair doth stand on end to hear her curses

lines.text: And so doth mine. I muse why she's at liberty.
lines.plainText: And so doth mine I muse why she's at liberty

lines.text: I cannot blame her. By God's holy mother,
lines.plainText: I cannot blame her By God's holy mother

lines.text: She hath had too much wrong; and I repent
lines.plainText: She hath had too much wrong and I repent

lines.text: My part thereof that I have done to her.
lines.plainText: My part thereof that I have done to her

lines.text: I never did her any, to my knowledge.
lines.plainText: I never did her any to my knowledge

lines.text: Yet you have all the vantage of her wrong.
lines.plainText: Yet you have all the vantage of her wrong

lines.text: I was too hot to do somebody good
lines.plainText: I was too hot to do somebody good

lines.text: That is too cold in thinking of it now.
lines.plainText: That is too cold in thinking of it now

lines.text: Marry, as for Clarence, he is well repaid;
lines.plainText: Marry as for Clarence he is well repaid

lines.text: He is franked up to fatting for his pains.
lines.plainText: He is franked up to fatting for his pains

lines.text: God pardon them that are the cause thereof.
lines.plainText: God pardon them that are the cause thereof

lines.text: A virtuous and a Christian-like conclusion,
lines.plainText: A virtuous and a Christianlike conclusion

lines.text: To pray for them that have done scathe to us.
lines.plainText: To pray for them that have done scathe to us

lines.text: So do I ever—(Speaks to himself) being well advised;
lines.plainText: So do I everSpeaks to himself being well advised

lines.text: For had I cursed now, I had cursed myself.
lines.plainText: For had I cursed now I had cursed myself

lines.text: Madam, his Majesty doth call for you,
lines.plainText: Madam his Majesty doth call for you

lines.text: And for your Grace, and you, my gracious lords.
lines.plainText: And for your Grace and you my gracious lords

lines.text: Catesby, I come. Lords, will you go with me?
lines.plainText: Catesby I come Lords will you go with me

lines.text: We wait upon your Grace.
lines.plainText: We wait upon your Grace

lines.text: I do the wrong, and first begin to brawl.
lines.plainText: I do the wrong and first begin to brawl

lines.text: The secret mischiefs that I set abroach
lines.plainText: The secret mischiefs that I set abroach

lines.text: I lay unto the grievous charge of others.
lines.plainText: I lay unto the grievous charge of others

lines.text: Clarence, whom I indeed have cast in darkness,
lines.plainText: Clarence whom I indeed have cast in darkness

lines.text: I do beweep to many simple gulls,
lines.plainText: I do beweep to many simple gulls

lines.text: Namely, to Derby, Hastings, Buckingham;
lines.plainText: Namely to Derby Hastings Buckingham

lines.text: And tell them 'tis the Queen and her allies
lines.plainText: And tell them 'tis the Queen and her allies

lines.text: That stir the King against the Duke my brother.
lines.plainText: That stir the King against the Duke my brother

lines.text: Now they believe it, and withal whet me
lines.plainText: Now they believe it and withal whet me

lines.text: To be revenged on Rivers, Dorset, Grey.
lines.plainText: To be revenged on Rivers Dorset Grey

lines.text: But then I sigh, and, with a piece of Scripture,
lines.plainText: But then I sigh and with a piece of Scripture

lines.text: Tell them that God bids us do good for evil;
lines.plainText: Tell them that God bids us do good for evil

lines.text: And thus I clothe my naked villany
lines.plainText: And thus I clothe my naked villany

lines.text: With odd old ends stol'n forth of Holy Writ,
lines.plainText: With odd old ends stol'n forth of Holy Writ

lines.text: And seem a saint when most I play the devil.
lines.plainText: And seem a saint when most I play the devil

lines.text: We are, my lord, and come to have the warrant,
lines.plainText: We are my lord and come to have the warrant

lines.text: That we may be admitted where he is.
lines.plainText: That we may be admitted where he is

lines.text: Well thought upon; I have it here about me.
lines.plainText: Well thought upon I have it here about me

lines.text: Tut, tut, my lord, we will not stand to prate.
lines.plainText: Tut tut my lord we will not stand to prate

lines.text: Talkers are no good doers. Be assured
lines.plainText: Talkers are no good doers Be assured

lines.text: We go to use our hands, and not our tongues.
lines.plainText: We go to use our hands and not our tongues

lines.text: Your eyes drop millstones when fools' eyes fall tears.
lines.plainText: Your eyes drop millstones when fools' eyes fall tears

lines.text: I like you, lads. About your business straight.
lines.plainText: I like you lads About your business straight

lines.text: Go, go, dispatch.
lines.plainText: Go go dispatch

lines.text: We will, my noble lord.
lines.plainText: We will my noble lord
